shortBio.en: Beatles bass and melody engine who keeps writing after the logo ends—Wings as proof of person > brand.
shortBio.zh: Beatles 的贝斯与旋律引擎，logo 结束后仍在写——Wings 证明人大于品牌。

whyHub.en: Beatles → Wings: the most famous logo-change in rock, same ear following one writer.
whyHub.zh: Beatles → Wings：摇滚最著名的换 logo，耳朵仍跟着同一个作者。

body.en:
McCartney is how you teach beginners that bands end and songs don't. Inside The Beatles he is half of the songwriting weather system; in Wings he rebuilds a touring life without pretending the sixties never happened.

On the graph he is a clean edge: Liverpool four-piece to post-Beatles vehicle.
body.zh:
教新人「乐队会结束、歌不会」时，McCartney 是最好的教具。在 Beatles 里他是作曲天气的一半；在 Wings 里他重建巡演人生，却不假装六十年代没发生过。

图上他是干净的一条边：利物浦四人组到后 Beatles 载具。
